notes: One client location; public endpoints; no credentials; no transactions.
Other local workloads made wall-clock CPU benchmarks noisy. CPU comparisons alternate implementations within one process and report medians.
Cache and plan: 9 pairs of 1,000,000 operations; mixed cache: 7 pairs of 1,000,000 operations; cached logs: 5 pairs of 10,000 reads of 1,000 logs.
Cold pool measurements are one request per configuration; hot measurements immediately repeat that request. These are observed samples, not latency guarantees.
